name: delegate
description: Consistent subagent deployment. A short delegation policy for the model, one nudge when a turn reads a lot without delegating, a check on each Agent call (deny once if the brief is vague or untagged, then add a return-format and done-when footer, block agents that start agents), caps on how many run at once, warnings at token and five-hour-window levels, five role agents, and /delegate score. Works beside agent-radar, which still picks model and effort. Reads usage numbers, tool names and Agent call fields. Sends nothing out and keeps only counts.

policyText.title: Add the delegation policy to the system prompt
policyText.description: Adds a short policy section to the system prompt and one note to the Agent tool's description. Takes effect for new sessions.

nudge.title: Nudge after a long read-only run
nudge.description: When one turn makes this many read-only calls in a row with no Agent call, the model gets one note about splitting the reads across subagents.

nudgeRun.title: Read-only calls before the nudge
nudgeRun.description: How many read-only calls in a row make a turn read-heavy. 0 turns the nudge off.

normalise.title: Check each Agent call
normalise.description: Deny a vague or untagged brief once, then add a return-format, done-when and no-spawn footer to a brief that lacks them.

requireTag.title: Require a difficulty tag
requireTag.description: Part of the check: a brief without [difficulty: ...] is denied once so that agent-radar can route it.

blockNested.title: Block agents that start agents
blockNested.description: A general-purpose, Explore or Plan subagent may not start another agent. Orchestrator agents from other plugins are not blocked.

maxLive.title: Most agents running at once
maxLive.description: A new agent is denied while this many run. 0 turns the cap off.

maxTurn.title: Most agents started in one turn

maxSession.title: Most agents started in one session

warnTokens.title: Subagent token warning
warnTokens.description: A toast shows when the subagents of this session have used this many input, cache-write and output tokens. Warn only: nothing is denied. 0 turns it off.

alertTokens.title: Subagent token alert
alertTokens.description: A second, stronger toast at this many tokens. Warn only. 0 turns it off.

warnWindow.title: Five-hour window warning (percent)
warnWindow.description: A toast shows when the five-hour window passes this percent. Warn only. 0 turns it off.

alertWindow.title: Five-hour window alert (percent)
alertWindow.description: A second toast at this percent. Warn only. 0 turns it off.
